_meta.description: Nuclei scan profiles for Artemis — bundled template tag presets

profiles.name: Kitchen Sink
profiles.description: Everything. All checks, all severities. Slow but thorough.
profiles.notes: No tag filter = all templates. May take a long time on large scans.

profiles.name: Quick Scan
profiles.description: Fast top-200 checks. Critical and high severity only.
profiles.notes: Best for rapid triage. Covers the most common/impactful vulns.

profiles.name: Linux
profiles.description: Linux-specific checks: SSH hardening, privilege escalation, misconfigs, common Linux services.
profiles.notes: Covers SSH config, Linux CVEs, service misconfigurations, local privesc vectors.

profiles.name: Windows / Microsoft
profiles.description: Windows and Microsoft stack: AD, Exchange, IIS, RDP, SMB, Azure.
profiles.notes: Active Directory, Exchange, IIS, RDP, SMB shares, Azure misconfigs.

profiles.name: Network Gear
profiles.description: Routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, network appliances.
profiles.notes: Cisco, Fortinet, D-Link, MikroTik, Ubiquiti, pfSense, generic network devices.

profiles.name: Web Applications
profiles.description: Web app vulns: XSS, SQLi, LFI, SSRF, SSTI, file upload, auth bypass.
profiles.notes: OWASP Top 10 style checks. Good for web servers and applications.

profiles.name: CMS
profiles.description: Content management systems: WordPress, Joomla, Drupal, and their plugins.
profiles.notes: Heavy on WordPress (1500+ plugin/theme checks). Also covers Joomla and Drupal.

profiles.name: Critical CVEs
profiles.description: Known exploited vulnerabilities and critical CVEs only.
profiles.notes: CVEs from CISA KEV catalog + critical/high severity. The 'patch these now' list.

profiles.name: Default Credentials
profiles.description: Check for default logins, exposed panels, and weak authentication.
profiles.notes: Finds admin panels with default creds, unauthenticated access, exposed services.

profiles.name: DevOps / Cloud
profiles.description: CI/CD, containers, cloud services, Kubernetes, DevSecOps checks.
profiles.notes: Jenkins, GitLab, K8s, Docker, cloud provider misconfigs, CI/CD pipeline security.

profiles.name: Recon / Discovery
profiles.description: Technology detection, service discovery, information disclosure.
profiles.notes: Non-intrusive. Identifies technologies, exposed files, debug endpoints, directory listings.

profiles.name: Malware / C2
profiles.description: Detect malware indicators, C2 frameworks, and compromised infrastructure.
profiles.notes: Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, known C2 JARM hashes, webshells, backdoors.
